ItemID: unavailable; Title: Speak Now; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My current mood favors older folk and classic-rock collections rather than contemporary country-pop.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: "Now" - Chicago XXXVI; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I would prefer familiar Chicago hits over exploring a newer studio album right now.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Duets; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Cheek to Cheek suggests I might enjoy another duet album, but the title alone leaves me unsure which artists are involved.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Ultimate Bee Gees: the 50th Anniversary Collection; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: A career-spanning collection fits my recent interest in familiar older songs and greatest-hits albums.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Neil Diamond All Time Greatest Hits; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: His melodic classics fit the older pop and singer-songwriter music I have been choosing.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Chicago Only The Beginning; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Familiar Chicago songs suit my interest in classic-rock hits and retrospective collections.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Aretha's Best; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: An older soul collection appeals, but I would choose folk and classic-pop favorites first this time.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: The Very Best of Peter, Paul and Mary; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Their folk harmonies fit especially well with my Simon & Garfunkel, Jonathan Edwards, and Melanie listening.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: The Best of INXS; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Their rock sound is less suited to my current interest in older folk and melodic pop collections.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: A Very Special Christmas 2; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I recently chose the first collection, so its follow-up is a timely way to continue that holiday listening.
